collapsed_bridge.name: Collapsed Bridge
collapsed_bridge.description: A marked bridge closes for two rounds; an alternate route remains open.

unstable_leyline.name: Unstable Leyline
unstable_leyline.description: One Tower yields +1 Power and has -1 Defence until Resolution.

monster_migration.name: Monster Migration
monster_migration.description: The camp nearest the richest hero gains +1 Health and Defence, up to two reinforcements.

cursed_ground.name: Cursed Ground
cursed_ground.description: A region's Plains cost Forest movement until Resolution; combat terrain is unchanged.

wandering_market.name: Wandering Market
wandering_market.description: An unoccupied neutral hex permits Trade until Resolution.
